CREATE VIEW [dbo].[ST_Balance_TMP_Plus_Negitave_V] AS
SELECT CONVERT(date, A.[DATE]) AS [DATE], A.IM_ID, A.ST_ID, A.D_Vaild, ISNULL(SUM(A.ST_QTY), 0) AS T_ST_QTY, A.Pch_T_ID AS Bill_T_ID FROM Pch_Details A WHERE A.isDepended = 1 GROUP BY A.IM_ID, A.ST_ID, A.D_Vaild, CONVERT(date, A.[DATE]), --(Price / U_Cargo), A.Pch_T_ID
UNION ALL
SELECT CONVERT(date, B.[DATE]) AS [DATE], B.IM_ID, B.ST_ID, B.D_Vaild, ISNULL(SUM(B.ST_QTY), 0) AS T_ST_QTY, B.Bill_T_ID AS Bill_T_ID FROM Rtn_Contents B WHERE B.isDepended = 1 AND B.Rtn_Type_ID = 1 GROUP BY B.IM_ID, B.ST_ID, B.D_Vaild, CONVERT(date, B.[DATE]), --(Cost / U_Cargo), B.Bill_T_ID
UNION ALL
SELECT CONVERT(date, C.[DATE]) AS [DATE], C.IM_ID, C.ST_To_ID AS ST_ID, C.D_Vaild, ISNULL(SUM(C.ST_QTY), 0) AS T_ST_QTY, C.B_T_ID AS Bill_T_ID FROM Store_Trans_Details C WHERE C.isDepended = 1 GROUP BY C.IM_ID, C.ST_To_ID, C.D_Vaild, CONVERT(date, C.[DATE]), --(Price / U_Cargo), C.B_T_ID
UNION ALL
SELECT CONVERT(date, D.[DATE]) AS [DATE], D.IM_ID, D.ST_ID, D.D_Vaild, ISNULL(SUM(D.ST_QTY), 0) AS T_ST_QTY, D.FRM_T_ID AS Bill_T_ID FROM FRM_Details D WHERE D.isDepended = 1 GROUP BY D.IM_ID, D.ST_ID, D.D_Vaild, CONVERT(date, D.[DATE]), --(Price / U_Cargo), D.FRM_T_ID
UNION ALL
SELECT CONVERT(date, E.[DATE]) AS [DATE], E.IM_ID, E.ST_ID, E.D_Vaild, ISNULL(SUM(E.ST_QTY), 0) AS T_ST_QTY, E.Outsale_T_ID AS Bill_T_ID FROM Outsale_Details E WHERE E.isDepended = 1 GROUP BY E.IM_ID, E.ST_ID, E.D_Vaild, E.T_ID, CONVERT(date, E.[DATE]), --(Cost / U_Cargo), E.Outsale_T_ID
UNION ALL
SELECT CONVERT(date, F.[DATE]) AS [DATE], F.IM_ID, F.ST_ID, F.Valid_D AS D_Vaild, ISNULL(SUM(F.ST_QTY), 0) * F.Cost AS T_COST, F.T_ID AS Bill_T_ID FROM ST_QTY_Deferences F WHERE F.ST_QTY > 0 GROUP BY F.IM_ID, F.ST_ID, F.Valid_D, CONVERT(date, F.[DATE]), F.Cost, F.T_ID
UNION ALL
SELECT CONVERT(date, A1.[DATE]) AS [DATE], A1.IM_ID, A1.ST_ID, A1.D_Vaild, ISNULL(SUM(A1.ST_QTY) * -1, 0) AS T_ST_QTY, A1.Bill_T_ID AS Bill_T_ID FROM SB_Contents A1 WHERE A1.isDepended = 1 GROUP BY A1.IM_ID, A1.ST_ID, A1.D_Vaild, CONVERT(date, A1.[DATE]), --(Cost / U_Cargo), A1.Bill_T_ID
UNION ALL
SELECT CONVERT(date, A2.[DATE]) AS [DATE], A2.IM_ID, A2.ST_ID, A2.D_Vaild, ISNULL(SUM(A2.ST_QTY) * -1, 0) AS T_ST_QTY, A2.Bill_T_ID AS Bill_T_ID FROM Rtn_Contents A2 WHERE A2.isDepended = 1 AND A2.Rtn_Type_ID = 7 GROUP BY A2.IM_ID, A2.ST_ID, A2.D_Vaild, CONVERT(date, A2.[DATE]), --(Cost / U_Cargo), A2.Bill_T_ID
UNION ALL
SELECT CONVERT(date, A3.[DATE]) AS [DATE], A3.IM_ID, A3.ST_f_ID AS ST_ID, A3.D_Vaild, ISNULL(SUM(A3.ST_QTY) * -1, 0) AS T_ST_QTY, A3.B_T_ID AS Bill_T_ID FROM Store_Trans_Details A3 WHERE A3.isDepended = 1 GROUP BY A3.IM_ID, A3.ST_f_ID, A3.D_Vaild, CONVERT(date, A3.[DATE]), --(Price / U_Cargo), A3.B_T_ID
UNION ALL
SELECT CONVERT(date, A4.[DATE]) AS [DATE], A4.IM_ID, A4.ST_ID, A4.D_Vaild, ISNULL(SUM(A4.ST_QTY) * -1, 0) AS T_ST_QTY, A4.IMEX_T_ID AS Bill_T_ID FROM IMEX_Details A4 WHERE A4.isDepended = 1 GROUP BY A4.IM_ID, A4.ST_ID, A4.D_Vaild, CONVERT(date, A4.[DATE]), --(Cost / U_Cargo), A4.IMEX_T_ID
UNION ALL
SELECT CONVERT(date, A5.[DATE]) AS [DATE], A5.IM_ID, A5.ST_ID, A5.D_Vaild, ISNULL(SUM(A5.ST_QTY) * -1, 0) AS T_ST_QTY, A5.InSale_T_ID AS Bill_T_ID FROM InSale_Details A5 WHERE A5.isDepended = 1 GROUP BY A5.IM_ID, A5.ST_ID, A5.D_Vaild, CONVERT(date, A5.[DATE]), --(Cost / U_Cargo), A5.InSale_T_ID
UNION ALL
SELECT CONVERT(date, A6.[DATE]) AS [DATE], A6.IM_ID, A6.ST_ID, A6.D_Vaild, ISNULL(SUM(A6.ST_QTY) * -1, 0) AS T_ST_QTY, A6.Bill_T_ID AS Bill_T_ID FROM FRM_Contents_Details A6 WHERE A6.isDepended = 1 AND ISNULL(A6.is_not_Qty, 0) <> 1 GROUP BY A6.IM_ID, A6.ST_ID, A6.D_Vaild, CONVERT(date, A6.[DATE]), --(Cost / U_Cargo), A6.Bill_T_ID
UNION ALL
SELECT CONVERT(date, A7.[DATE]) AS [DATE], A7.Struct_ID AS IM_ID, A7.ST_ID, '' AS D_Vaild, ISNULL(SUM(A7.ST_QTY) * -1, 0) AS T_ST_QTY, A7.SB_Cont_T_ID AS Bill_T_ID FROM SB_Contents_Structers A7 WHERE A7.isDepended = 1 GROUP BY A7.Struct_ID, A7.ST_ID, CONVERT(date, A7.[DATE]), --(Cost / U_Cargo), A7.SB_Cont_T_ID

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[VW_InventoryTransactionFlow] AS
/* ========================================================= PURCHASE ========================================================= */ SELECT CAST('PURCHASE' AS nvarchar(50)) AS MovementType, CAST('Pch_Details' AS nvarchar(100)) AS SourceTable,
CAST(T_ID AS bigint) AS SourceId, CAST(Pch_T_ID AS bigint) AS SourceParentId,
IM_ID, ST_ID,
U_ID, CAST(U_Cargo AS decimal(18,6)) AS U_Cargo, CAST(QYT AS decimal(18,6)) AS UnitQty,
[Date],
CAST(ST_QTY AS decimal(18,6)) AS QtyIn, CAST(0 AS decimal(18,6)) AS QtyOut,
CAST((Price / NULLIF(U_Cargo,0)) AS decimal(18,6)) AS UnitCost, CAST((ST_QTY * (Price / NULLIF(U_Cargo,0))) AS decimal(18,6)) AS TotalCost,
CAST(1 AS bit) AS AffectCost
FROM dbo.Pch_Details WHERE isDepended = 1
UNION ALL
/* ========================================================= SALES ========================================================= */ SELECT CAST('SALE' AS nvarchar(50)), CAST('SB_Contents' AS nvarchar(100)),
CAST(T_ID AS bigint), CAST(Bill_T_ID AS bigint),
IM_ID, ST_ID,
U_ID, CAST(U_Cargo AS decimal(18,6)), CAST(QTY AS decimal(18,6)),
[Date],
CAST(0 AS decimal(18,6)), CAST(ST_QTY AS decimal(18,6)),
CAST(Cost AS decimal(18,6)), CAST((ST_QTY * Cost) AS decimal(18,6)),
CAST(0 AS bit)
FROM dbo.SB_Contents WHERE isDepended = 1
UNION ALL
/* ========================================================= SALES RETURN ========================================================= */ SELECT CAST('SALE_RETURN' AS nvarchar(50)), CAST('Rtn_Contents' AS nvarchar(100)),
CAST(T_ID AS bigint), CAST(Bill_T_ID AS bigint),
IM_ID, ST_ID,
U_ID, CAST(U_Cargo AS decimal(18,6)), CAST(QTY AS decimal(18,6)),
[Date],
CAST(ST_QTY AS decimal(18,6)), CAST(0 AS decimal(18,6)),
CAST(Cost AS decimal(18,6)), CAST((ST_QTY * Cost) AS decimal(18,6)),
CAST(0 AS bit)
FROM dbo.Rtn_Contents WHERE isDepended = 1 AND Rtn_Type_ID = 1
UNION ALL
/* ========================================================= PURCHASE RETURN ========================================================= */ SELECT CAST('PCH_RETURN' AS nvarchar(50)), CAST('Rtn_Contents' AS nvarchar(100)),
CAST(T_ID AS bigint), CAST(Bill_T_ID AS bigint),
IM_ID, ST_ID,
U_ID, CAST(U_Cargo AS decimal(18,6)), CAST(QTY AS decimal(18,6)),
[Date],
CAST(0 AS decimal(18,6)), CAST(ST_QTY AS decimal(18,6)),
CAST(Cost AS decimal(18,6)), CAST((ST_QTY * Cost) AS decimal(18,6)),
CAST(0 AS bit)
FROM dbo.Rtn_Contents WHERE isDepended = 1 AND Rtn_Type_ID = 7
UNION ALL
/* ========================================================= DAMAGE / ITEM EXPORT ========================================================= */ SELECT CAST('DAMAGE' AS nvarchar(50)), CAST('IMEX_Details' AS nvarchar(100)),
CAST(T_ID AS bigint), CAST(IMEX_T_ID AS bigint),
IM_ID, ST_ID,
U_ID, CAST(U_Cargo AS decimal(18,6)), CAST(QYT AS decimal(18,6)),
[Date],
CAST(0 AS decimal(18,6)), CAST(ST_QTY AS decimal(18,6)),
CAST(Cost AS decimal(18,6)), CAST((ST_QTY * Cost) AS decimal(18,6)),
CAST(0 AS bit)
FROM dbo.IMEX_Details WHERE isDepended = 1
UNION ALL
/* ========================================================= ISSUE IN ========================================================= */ SELECT CAST('ISSUE_IN' AS nvarchar(50)), CAST('InSale_Details' AS nvarchar(100)),
CAST(T_ID AS bigint), CAST(InSale_T_ID AS bigint),
IM_ID, ST_ID,
U_ID, CAST(U_Cargo AS decimal(18,6)), CAST(QYT AS decimal(18,6)),
[Date],
CAST(0 AS decimal(18,6)), CAST(ST_QTY AS decimal(18,6)),
CAST(Cost AS decimal(18,6)), CAST((ST_QTY * Cost) AS decimal(18,6)),
CAST(0 AS bit)
FROM dbo.InSale_Details WHERE isDepended = 1
UNION ALL
/* ========================================================= ISSUE OUT ========================================================= */ SELECT CAST('ISSUE_OUT' AS nvarchar(50)), CAST('Outsale_Details' AS nvarchar(100)),
CAST(T_ID AS bigint), CAST(Outsale_T_ID AS bigint),
IM_ID, ST_ID,
U_ID, CAST(U_Cargo AS decimal(18,6)), CAST(QYT AS decimal(18,6)),
[Date],
CAST(0 AS decimal(18,6)), CAST(ST_QTY AS decimal(18,6)),
CAST(Cost AS decimal(18,6)), CAST((ST_QTY * Cost) AS decimal(18,6)),
CAST(0 AS bit)
FROM dbo.Outsale_Details WHERE isDepended = 1
UNION ALL
/* ========================================================= STORE TRANSFER FROM ========================================================= */ SELECT CAST('STORE_TRANS_FROM' AS nvarchar(50)), CAST('Store_Trans_Details' AS nvarchar(100)),
CAST(T_ID AS bigint), CAST(B_T_ID AS bigint),
IM_ID, ST_F_ID AS ST_ID,
U_ID, CAST(U_Cargo AS decimal(18,6)), CAST(QTY AS decimal(18,6)),
[Date],
CAST(0 AS decimal(18,6)), CAST(ST_QTY AS decimal(18,6)),
CAST(Price AS decimal(18,6)), CAST((ST_QTY * Price) AS decimal(18,6)),
CAST(0 AS bit)
FROM dbo.Store_Trans_Details WHERE isDepended = 1
UNION ALL
/* ========================================================= STORE TRANSFER TO ========================================================= */ SELECT CAST('STORE_TRANS_TO' AS nvarchar(50)), CAST('Store_Trans_Details' AS nvarchar(100)),
CAST(T_ID AS bigint), CAST(B_T_ID AS bigint),
IM_ID, ST_TO_ID AS ST_ID,
U_ID, CAST(U_Cargo AS decimal(18,6)), CAST(QTY AS decimal(18,6)),
[Date],
CAST(ST_QTY AS decimal(18,6)), CAST(0 AS decimal(18,6)),
CAST(Price AS decimal(18,6)), CAST((ST_QTY * Price) AS decimal(18,6)),
CAST(0 AS bit)
FROM dbo.Store_Trans_Details WHERE isDepended = 1
UNION ALL
/* ========================================================= STORE DIFFERENCE ملاحظة: إذا كان ST_QTY موجب = دخول إذا كان ST_QTY سالب = خروج ========================================================= */ SELECT CAST('STORE_DIFF' AS nvarchar(50)), CAST('ST_QTY_Deferences' AS nvarchar(100)),
CAST(T_ID AS bigint), CAST(Bill_T_ID AS bigint),
IM_ID, ST_ID,
CAST(1 AS bigint) AS U_ID, CAST(U_Cargo AS decimal(18,6)), CAST(ST_QTY AS decimal(18,6)),
[Date],
CASE WHEN ST_QTY > 0 THEN CAST(ST_QTY AS decimal(18,6)) ELSE CAST(0 AS decimal(18,6)) END AS QtyIn,
CASE WHEN ST_QTY < 0 THEN CAST(ABS(ST_QTY) AS decimal(18,6)) ELSE CAST(0 AS decimal(18,6)) END AS QtyOut,
CAST(Cost AS decimal(18,6)), CAST((ABS(ST_QTY) * Cost) AS decimal(18,6)),
CAST(0 AS bit)
FROM dbo.ST_QTY_Deferences
UNION ALL
/* ========================================================= FORMING / MANUFACTURING CONTENT ========================================================= */ SELECT CAST('FRM_IM' AS nvarchar(50)), CAST('FRM_Contents_Details' AS nvarchar(100)),
CAST(T_ID AS bigint), CAST(Bill_T_ID AS bigint),
IM_ID, ST_ID,
CAST(U_ID AS bigint) AS U_ID, CAST(U_Cargo AS decimal(18,6)), CAST(ST_QTY AS decimal(18,6)),
[Date],
CAST(0 AS decimal(18,6)), CAST(ST_QTY AS decimal(18,6)),
CAST(Cost AS decimal(18,6)), CAST((ST_QTY * Cost) AS decimal(18,6)),
CAST(0 AS bit)
FROM dbo.FRM_Contents_Details WHERE isDepended = 1
UNION ALL
/* ========================================================= FORMING / MANUFACTURING DETAILS ========================================================= */ SELECT CAST('FRM_IM_PLUS' AS nvarchar(50)), CAST('FRM_Details' AS nvarchar(100)),
CAST(T_ID AS bigint), CAST(FRM_T_ID AS bigint),
IM_ID, ST_ID,
CAST(U_ID AS bigint) AS U_ID, CAST(U_Cargo AS decimal(18,6)), CAST(ST_QTY AS decimal(18,6)),
[Date],
CAST(ST_QTY AS decimal(18,6)), CAST(0 AS decimal(18,6)),
CAST(Price AS decimal(18,6)), CAST((ST_QTY * Price) AS decimal(18,6)),
CAST(0 AS bit)
